name: Oracle
ability: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
wakes: Each night except the first, after the Demon acts.
interaction: Learns: The number of dead players who are (register as) evil.
drunk_or_poisoned: Drunk or poisoned: may learn any number (misinformation offered centrally, storyteller picks).

rulings.text: Counts every evil dead player, including evil Travellers and Townsfolk/Outsiders turned evil.
The Oracle wakes after the Demon, so tonight's kills are included.

test_scenarios.name: zero evil dead
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Oracle, Bob Flowergirl, Carol Juggler, Dave Fang Gu, Eve Witch.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Bob executed. Night 2: Fang Gu kills Carol.

test_scenarios.name: counts tonight's minion kill and exiled evil traveller
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Oracle, Bob Witch, Carol Vigormortis, Dave Gangster (evil traveller), Eve Mutant, Fay Sage.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Dave exiled. Night 3: Vigormortis kills Bob.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned oracle
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Oracle, Bob No Dashii (Alice's neighbour), Carol Cerenovus, Dave Witch (dead), Eve Sage.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 3: Alice is poisoned by the No Dashii; misinformation options offered centrally, storyteller picks 0.

test_scenarios.name: dead recluse registers evil
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Oracle, Bob Recluse (dead), Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: storyteller has Bob register as evil.
